description: Axle is where independent contractors, small companies and their workers run field work: tickets, jobs, hours, jobsites and safety records, in one place. This connector lets an Axle member use their own ChatGPT account to ask about their own work. Sign in with your everyday Axle login; ChatGPT sees exactly what you can see and nothing else. Ask what jobs you are on, which tickets are open, what you did this week, your hours for a period, your jobsites, and which safety tickets are expiring; ask for a situation report on your workforce, tickets or locations. No tool takes another person, company or workforce as input, so nobody can be asked about anyone else's work. Rates, costs and pay are never returned. A connection can be switched off at your company's request at any time.

defaultPrompt: Show my safety certifications and their expiry dates.
Summarize my assigned jobs and tickets for today.
Show my recorded work hours for this week.
